feats/aberrant-dragonmark-2.name: Aberrant Dragonmark
feats/aberrant-dragonmark-2.effectSummary: Choose one aberrant dragonmark spell-like ability when taking the feat: burning hands, cause fear, charm person, chill touch, detect secret doors, feather fall, inflict light wounds, jump, light, pass without trace, produce flame, shield, or Tenser's floating disk. The chosen ability is usable once per day, is always treated as a 1st-level spell for save DC 10 + 1 + Charisma modifier, and has caster level equal to half your character level. The mark cannot be improved and you cannot gain a second aberrant mark. Aberrant Dragonmark and any true dragonmark feat are mutually exclusive.

feats/aberration-banemagic-7.name: Aberration Banemagic
feats/aberration-banemagic-7.effectSummary: A damaging spell you cast deals +2d6 damage to aberrations and its save DC increases by 2. A single casting gains the extra damage only once per affected aberration even if it creates multiple simultaneous hits, but a spell that deals damage across multiple rounds applies the extra damage each round. The bonus damage follows the base spell's save result: it is halved or negated on a successful save as the spell's normal damage is. Scrolls, wands, potions, and most other magic items do not gain the feat's benefit; staffs you activate do, because they use your caster level.
